hypothesis.title: PD35 — KR Lottery-Preference Penalty Composite (3-Factor) — 5th Exploratory Alpha Source
hypothesis.description: 한국 시장 retail-heavy 구조 + 글로벌 lottery preference penalty 메커니즘. 3-factor expanding-IC-aligned composite under KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 universe + L05 liquidity filter (M22_Max_Return + D43_Skewness + D58_Vol_Asymmetry). L42 (Volume Skewness mismatch) Codex C6 ACCEPT 후 REMOVED. 학술: 투자자가 '복권성' 종목 (high MAX return, positive skew, downside vol asymmetry)에 ex-ante 과지불 → ex-post underperform → high-lottery 종목 매도, low-lottery 매수가 alpha 산출. KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 대형주 한정 retail attention bias 영향 약화로 alpha 보수적 (~0.02 IC Pre-LB).

primary_papers.citation: Bali, T. G., Cakici, N., & Whitelaw, R. F. (2011). 'Maxing out: Stocks as lotteries and the cross-section of expected returns.' Journal of Financial Economics, 99(2), 427-446.
primary_papers.mechanism: Investors over-pay for stocks with high maximum daily returns (MAX) in past month → lottery preference penalty → ex-post underperform.

primary_papers.citation: Boyer, B., Mitton, T., & Vorkink, K. (2010). 'Expected idiosyncratic skewness.' Review of Financial Studies, 23(1), 169-202.
primary_papers.mechanism: Ex-ante idio skewness — investors prefer positive-skew → high-skew stocks earn ~7% annual underperformance.

primary_papers.citation: Kumar, A. (2009). 'Who gambles in the stock market?' Journal of Finance, 64(4), 1889-1933.
primary_papers.mechanism: Retail-concentrated lottery preference. KR retail share ~50% (KOFIA 2023) → MAX effect amplified.

primary_papers.citation: Ang, A., Chen, J., & Xing, Y. (2006). 'Downside risk.' Review of Financial Studies, 19(4), 1191-1239.
primary_papers.mechanism: Asymmetric vol → asymmetric loss aversion (Kahneman-Tversky 1979). Downside beta premium.

primary_papers.citation: Harvey, C. R., Liu, Y., & Zhu, H. (2016). '… and the cross-section of expected returns.' RFS 29(1), 5-68.
